page_title: UNI 0-0 FRE | Union Berlin v Freiburg 01/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+7' Referee Soren Storks has finally had enough of Steffen Baumgart and brandishes a yellow card at him!
90+7' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Freiburg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+6' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
90+4' Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
90+3' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Union Berlin, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+1' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
90' The resulting set piece from Union Berlin is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
89' Julian Schuster has decided to substitute Lucas Holer and he is replaced by Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg).
88' Alex Kral (Union Berlin) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
87' Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) drills a shot towards goal after the ball is whipped into the penalty area, but it goes miles wide of the left post.
86' The manager makes a subsitution with Oliver Burke (Union Berlin) coming on for Andrej Ilic.

85' Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) displays brilliant awareness inside the six-yard box and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the top of the net, but Frederik Ronnow keeps the ball out.
84' Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) gets booked for the first time in this match.
83' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
80' Steffen Baumgart decides to make a substitution. Derrick Kohn will be replaced by Tom Rothe (Union Berlin).
80' Substitution. Aljoscha Kemlein makes his way off the pitch and Alex Kral (Union Berlin) comes on as his replacement.

79' Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
79' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Soren Storks no option but to blow his whistle.
78' Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
77' Poor challenge! Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) is penalised for tripping and Soren Storks blows his whistle. Freiburg have a free kick.
76' The free kick from long range, taken by Freiburg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
76' Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
74' Julian Schuster prepares a substitution. Vincenzo Grifo is replaced by Derry Scherhant (Freiburg).
74' Substitution. Jan-Niklas Beste leaves the pitch and is replaced by Lukas Kubler (Freiburg).
74' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) steps up to send the ball in.

74' Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the roof of the net, but Frederik Ronnow thwarts him with a great two-handed save. Freiburg earn a corner.
73' Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Frederik Ronnow has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
72' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

72' Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin) has a sight of goal and shoots towards the right post, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save. Union Berlin force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
69' Celebrations are cut short for Union Berlin as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
68' The attendance for today's match is 22012.
66' Wait! The referee has now indicated he wants to check if the goal for Union Berlin can stand using VAR.
65' Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

63' It's a goal! Christopher Trimmel delivers a teasing cross from the resulting corner and the ball falls into the space where Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) is lurking. His bullet of a shot from close range goes low into the middle of the goal and it's 1:0.
62' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
61' Steffen Baumgart has decided to make a change. Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin) replaces Tim Skarke.
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Janik Haberer leaves the pitch and Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) comes on.
57' A player from Union Berlin pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Freiburg.
55' Soren Storks blows for a foul after Lucas Holer (Freiburg) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
54' The corner is flicked onto Lucas Holer (Freiburg), but his close-range header flies just over the bar.
54' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

54' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) steps up to take a free kick and sends it in, but the opposition's defence is alert and clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play and Freiburg manage to earn a corner.
53' Soren Storks interrupts the game. One of the players from Union Berlin won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Freiburg are awarded the free kick.
52' Soren Storks blows his whistle after Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
50' Union Berlin couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Noah Atubolu (Freiburg) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
49' The free kick into the penalty area from Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) is cleared.
47' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Union Berlin.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+3' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
45+3' Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
45+2' Tim Skarke (Union Berlin) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Soren Storks saw the whole situation.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) will take a corner kick.
44' Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) misses a good chance to score. A perfect cross into the box finds Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) who rises for a header, but he sends the ball well over the bar.

43' Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Vincenzo Grifo, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
41' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) is able to continue to play.
41' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) picks up an injury.
39' Substitution. Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) has come on for Junior Adamu.
39' Junior Adamu (Freiburg) times his leap well to meet the lofted pass from Vincenzo Grifo, but his close-range header slips just over the bar.

38' Golden chance! Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
32' The referee signals a free kick from long distance for Union Berlin.
31' Soren Storks blows his whistle after Junior Adamu (Freiburg) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
28' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) receives a harsh yellow card from the referee after committing a minor foul on his opponent.
27' That was a poorly executed free kick from long distance. Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) was trying to produce a cross into the penalty area, but his effort sailed off the pitch.

27' Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Soren Storks blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Freiburg have a free kick.
25' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
24' Aljoscha Kemlein (Union Berlin) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
23' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Frederik Ronnow.
19' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Freiburg due to a handball in the build-up play.
18' Wait! Referee Soren Storks has indicated he is going to review the Freiburg goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a handball in the build-up.
17' Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the left side of the goal. The score is 0:1.
17' Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
15' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Freiburg will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
12' A clumsy foul by Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) and Soren Storks blows his whistle.
12' Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the left side of the target, but Frederik Ronnow easily deals with the threat.

10' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) controls the ball from the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal. The goalkeeper has a clear sight of the shot and thwarts him with a comfortable save.
9' The ball is out of play. Union Berlin will have a chance to score from a corner.
9' Max Rosenfelder (Freiburg) sends a long ball in, but Frederik Ronnow comfortably gathers the ball.
6' Tim Skarke (Union Berlin) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
5' Freiburg take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

5' Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) receives a clever chip pass into a promising position. Nevertheless, one of the defenders is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The linesman points to the corner flag, Freiburg are going to take it.

2' Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) wins the ball inside the goal area from the resulting set piece and unleashes a shot which sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Freiburg will have a goal kick.
2' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
2' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
1' Junior Adamu (Freiburg) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Union Berlin will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Soren Storks.
